command:
set -euo pipefail
REPO=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomaps/work
MAIN_SHA=dcd99f07faf9e159a1b6b3f0b76ccff1e9db8ce1
WORK_SHA=578281bf750d7c86792ba4d6ccde505a7678c01f
TAG=pre-photomap-audit-20260913
BRANCH=work/photomap-straighten-20260912
cd "$REPO"
git fetch origin main "$BRANCH" --tags
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$MAIN_SHA"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$WORK_SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/tags/$TAG" || git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin "refs/tags/$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "tag already exists: $TAG"; exit 1; fi
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$MAIN_SHA" "$WORK_SHA"
git tag -a "$TAG" "$MAIN_SHA" -m 'Rollback point before audited PhotoMap merge on 2026-09-13'
git push origin "refs/tags/$TAG"
git push origin "$WORK_SHA:refs/heads/main"
git fetch origin main --tags
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$WORK_SHA"
test "$(git rev-parse "$TAG^{commit}")" = "$MAIN_SHA"
echo TAG=$TAG
echo TAG_SHA=$(git rev-parse "$TAG^{commit}")
echo MAIN_SHA=$(git rev-parse origin/main)
